name: XX Campeonato Mundial de Pelota Vasca
transcriptionMethod: Visual extraction with Claude Haiku 5.5, checked against positioned PDF text and source headers.
caveats: Times reproduce the printed local schedule. Colonia and Buenos Aires share the same UTC offset during this event.
The source revision label is reproduced literally and is not a verified publication date.
The source does not specify a Frontball venue.
Frontball entries and the four Cesta Punta entries on October 20 are retained as source sessions; grouped sessions have not been expanded into invented individual matches.
Some future participants are undecided; null participants preserve that absence.
Null gender means the source does not explicitly identify it. The Cesta Punta continuation on October 16 also has no exact start time.

The source labels 26 Frontón 30m sessions as Pelota Goma. The official General Rules (Reglamento general de juego, section 4.6) define only Paleta Goma, with a wooden, carbon or fiberglass paddle and a rubber ball, so those sessions are normalized to modality Paleta Goma.

uncertainties: Gender is not explicitly identified for the continuation after INAUGURACIÓN.
